scope: Test fixture timing correction and bounded modeled host checks; not real browser, full-source or public qualification.

hostedFailure.boundary: The 100-setImmediate test loop exhausted before mocked setLook was called. The candidate had not reached artwork decoding. The duration covers the whole test, not a measured wait interval.

cause: verifyReplayAsync yields with setTimeout(0) before work and between bounded simulation chunks. A fixed number of immediate callbacks can be exhausted before those timers run.

correction.change: Import existing waitFor; until(predicate,label) awaits waitFor(predicate,{message:label}) using unchanged default 5000 ms.

otherFixedTurnWaits.boundary: Explicit file.text deferred promise resolved after Back; existing current-generation guard immediately returns after the source await.
Explicit file.text deferred promise resolved after pagehide; disposed/generation guard immediately returns after the source await.
Explicit setLook deferred promise resolved after Cancel; current-generation guard immediately returns before adopting nextPlayer/nextPainter.

postResolutionAssessment: These three drains follow controlled promise resolutions whose production continuations and stale guards are microtask-only. They are not the real timer-driven verification readiness waits and remain unchanged, with their old-run/candidate/disposal assertions.

controlledReproduction.boundary: Only existing zero-delay timers while Navigation recording is loaded and candidate stage is verifying; no source transformation. The same preloader bytes were used before/after the test-only correction.
controlledReproduction.apiCleanup: Each isolated Node process restores global setTimeout on exit.
controlledReproduction.limitation: This controlled timer delay demonstrates the readiness-loop flaw; it does not claim to reproduce the precise hosted scheduler.
